newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP says Scor report false.
newsitem.headline: UAP says Scor report false.

text.p: PARIS, Nov 29 (Retuer) - French insurer UAP denied on Friday an article in a weekly newspaper which reported that reinsurer Scor was about to lose a major reinsurance contract when UAP merges with rival Axa.
"This report is without foundation," said a UAP spokeswoman. "We deny it for the reason that Scor is not the lead insurer right now of our reinsurance contracts."
She said the lead reinsurer for UAP was Munich Re. Scor fell more than three percent on the report before recovering to trade down 1.65 percent at 184.4 francs at 1142 GMT.
"The new Axa/UAP would not long re-insure 'big risks' through Scor, but would turn to Munich Re or Jardine, which have more competitive rates," the weekly La Vie Francaise reported.
"What we know is that UAP did not have Scor as its lead manager for major risks," said an Axa spokeswoman. "We are just trying to find out how much business Axa represents for Scor.
"But in any case, as in everything being discussed about what will happen after UAP merges with Axa, all of this talk is completely premature. No decision has been taken."
